cause_and_method_boundary.original_algorithm: Official LC-Rec independently tokenizes the input prompt and full prompt+answer+EOS, masking labels by the independently tokenized prompt positions. It does not prove that the prompt token IDs are a prefix of the full encoding.
cause_and_method_boundary.current_qwen_adapter: Preserves that algorithm and the exact original natural-language bytes. attention_mask replaces PAD-token equality solely to preserve genuine EOS when Qwen PAD equals EOS.
cause_and_method_boundary.new_qwen_effect: Byte-BPE merges across the colon/answer boundary frequently in the three text-output tasks. Keeping the old positional mask therefore does not preserve complete answer-text supervision for every record.
